title.en: The meta-attractor (元吸引子 / 总体化吸引子)

summary.en: The folder argues that winning buys power over the rule that selects, across minds, institutions and infrastructure, ending in lost independent capacity to correct, with AI as hinge; the account proves the rule loop only on premises and keeps the word for closed capture, apart from the corpus's wide working definition. Tested, the correspondences report is half right: CAOC has no live home and totalization, plurality, Moloch and the other comparisons have no term or law, but the anti-attractor case is an explicit reading, the guardian question is stated and plurality's and totalization's parts are read. Divergences kept: exit order, prescribed ends, unconditional refusal of expendability, the claim to originality.

name.en: The word: pathological, engineered, then neutral and wide

source.locator: Opening definition; compare README Terms and open questions 11, 34

sense.en: The word first named a pathology, then in one October 2025 essay a desirable engineered rule region. On 8 October 2026 Ren selected a neutral working definition: recurrent organization whose consequences help reproduce the conditions selecting it, across carriers. The reconciliation supersedes reserving the word for pathology.

entries.quote: A meta-attractor is a recurrent organization of activity whose consequences help reproduce the conditions selecting that organization

reading.en: The account keeps 元吸引子 for something narrower than either: closed capture, where rule and reading are both formed from the share and nothing reads beyond it. It names the corpus's definition and says the word never means it. So the folder's adopted sense and the account's differ in reference; the same word does not mean the same object. [AI reading]

says.en: Meta-attractor: closed capture. "It never means the corpus's working definition"; that sense is wider, the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers, and whether a capture loop is 生成 at some pair of classes stays Open.
Definition: a loop of selection whose rule and whose reading of the rule are both formed from the share it selects, nothing in it reading what lies beyond the share.

account_adds.en: A definition exact enough for theorems, and a sentence saying the wide sense is not it.

source_adds.en: The wide neutral definition as the word's sense; a separate vocabulary (destructive capture regime, revision-supporting regime) that the account does not use.

name.en: A way of succeeding reproduced across carriers

source.locator: The power formulation, Selecting the selectors; claims 103, 251; GENERATIVE-REGIMES, What the definition requires

sense.en: What persists can be a way of succeeding, not a person, organization or ideology, so replacing occupants may leave the trajectory unchanged, though responsibility still differs. GENERATIVE-REGIMES requires organization, actual selection, causal return into selecting conditions, traceable succession and renewed activity, and its checked cycle gives a basin and rising exit cost.

entries.quote: It can be a way of succeeding.

reading.en: Two laws sit apart: passing (a pattern outlasting brief carriers is passed, under a supplied premise) and capture through the rule (silent on carriers). The join is the open question the account names. One reading says withdrawing one practice does not end the returning relation. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; any web). Under the passing premise, supplied, a pattern present from T with carriers brief for d is passed across one of every d consecutive steps. It says nothing of which patterns are worth passing.
Open: whether a capture loop (§9) is 生成 at some pair of classes.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: a real loss need not form a meta-attractor, and withdrawing one practice does not end the returning relation.

account_adds.en: The exact passing law, and the statement that the join is open.

source_adds.en: The joined claim itself; turnover of actors leaving the relation intact; the structural-explanation clause on responsibility; the checked selection-and-maintenance cycle and its exit-cost example, which stand in experiments and a study, not in the chapters.

name.en: The second-order core: state and selection rule in one loop

source.locator: Where the second order enters; claims 20-27

sense.en: An attractor in the joint space of states and rules: winners write the next scorecard. A region is a meta-attractor if trajectories enter and stay, the cross-product γ of rule-to-state and state-to-rule gains is positive, and long-run behaviour maximizes the proxy whatever it was invented for. Four ingredients are stated as jointly necessary.

entries.quote: a feedback loop that optimises its own optimiser

reading.en: The loop has the form of RuleCapture: Raises (selection does not lower the share under a favouring rule) and ReadsShare (the rule is a monotone function of the share). Those premises replace γ > 0. The reconciliation, a study, rejects γ as a sufficient criterion since two negative links also multiply positive. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). With selection not lowering the share under a favouring rule and the rule read monotonically from the share, start and every reading favouring, the course locks after its first reading step. "That actual rules read the share is the premise."

account_adds.en: "The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours"; reading against the share does not ratchet (a separate theorem); a discrete proof for any type.

source_adds.en: γ and the lifted F/G dynamics; means turning into ends; the claim that the four ingredients are necessary. The account gives sufficient premises and no necessity claim.

name.en: Partial reform is re-absorbed

source.locator: Where the second order enters; claim 28

sense.en: Fixing the state while leaving the rule operator intact lets the rule re-derive the old state, so escaping a meta-attractor needs simultaneous disruption of state and rule.

entries.quote: exiting requires simultaneous disruption of both state and rule; partial reforms are re-absorbed.

reading.en: The account gives where this holds. A perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step, and where the reading too is formed from the share a change of reading of any size is absorbed. But a perturbation reversing direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed, with no simultaneous change of rule. The universal form is corrected. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step (`Law.perturbation_reabsorbed`).
Theorem (any type; witness). A perturbation reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed (`RuleCapture.Reversed.not_absorbed`).
Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

account_adds.en: The threshold case that escapes absorption.

source_adds.en: The prescription that exit needs both at once, which the account's witness does not support as a general law.

name.en: The metric survives its own refutation

source.locator: Where the second order enters; claims 122, 267

sense.en: Goodhart says a target stops measuring; this says why it stays in use: by the time it has failed, those it elevated decide whether it is replaced. Winning gives a strategy power to prevent its destructiveness from counting as failure.

entries.quote: the metric survives its own refutation

reading.en: Proved part: the lock outlives a coordinate the loop does not read. That actual metrics are so formed is thesis T7, conjectured, with no field test. Noise leaves the critical mass's locks. In one trained judge the lock formed and the bridge failed: one note of the loss turned its reading. The unread coordinate is a loss only by reading. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Under Unread and the premises named, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked (`ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss`); a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, a sufficient way out.

Thesis T7: in the model only invariance under what the loop does not read and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate are proved, both without noise. Evidence, refutation and institutions are unformalized; that actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.

account_adds.en: What T7 forbids and what refutes it; the frozen LA2 test and its counterexample for trained judges.

source_adds.en: The institutional account of who keeps the metric; reclassifying failures as evidence for more of the same.

name.en: The selected begins to select the selectors

source.locator: Claims 31, 249; The power formulation

sense.en: A direction selected by existing conditions acquires power over later selection, reproducing its selectors, participant forms, signals, infrastructures and perceived possibility. The transition is from being selected by a rule to helping reproduce it, through ordinary reasonable decisions such as hiring and teaching.

entries.quote: 被选择的，开始选择选择者

reading.en: Read as the pool: the rule is read from the share exactly where each kind reads at least as favourably for its own kind, and who reads, and when, decides whether a reading of the loss turns the course. The premise moves to who reads and is not removed. The one test found one judge not such a pool. [AI reading, D67]

says.en: Theorem (any type). The pool's rule is a monotone function of the share exactly where `v` is not above `u`. "That actual rules are pools of readers so drawn, each kind reading at least as favourably for its own kind, is not shown."

account_adds.en: The exact condition, and the witness in which the same readers read in time turn the course and read late keep it.

source_adds.en: The formation of participants, infrastructures and perceived possibility; closing through ordinary decisions. "That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading."

name.en: Selection for control over selection, and its conditions

source.locator: Selection for control over selection; claims 268-272, open question 40

sense.en: Where practices vary heritably in capacity to reshape selection and the returns come back in time to beat their cost, recursive selection favours more control. Five conditions; shared returns flip the sign; the return grows superlinearly with domains occupied; assistance that cuts cost multiplies capacity. Derived in an unreviewed AI-drafted paper.

entries.quote: Recursive selection creates second-order selection pressure for mechanisms that increase control over future selection.

reading.en: The account states the conditional form in counts: at a step, what comes back to the shapers alone against cost decides the direction, and shaped groups add assortment. Appropriability χ reads as what comes back, through neighbours too. Offspring carrying the capacity is a premise. With nothing back and a cost, the share falls. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where `c ≤ s`, whatever `p` comes to every member alike; across a stretch the base and shared part enter too.
Theorem (counts). In groups of `m` the whole selects shaping exactly where `c < s + m q ρ`, read over the rationals, Hamilton's rule with what comes back alone added.
Theorem (counts). With `lo ≤ hi`, lock and capacity are one loop on either side of a critical mass, without noise; readers drawn so and offspring carrying the capacity are premises.

account_adds.en: Below the critical mass control falls and the course is still locked the other way; the frozen LA3 test, two of four contrasts failing.

source_adds.en: Superlinear return in domains, graded capacity and the capacity–capture ratchet, which 02 lists as Open; persistent-entry shifts of thresholds.

name.en: Four coupled layers and capture across domains of a field

source.locator: The field formalization; one-paragraph theory; claims 30, 102, 104

sense.en: The loop runs across cognitive, intersubjective, institutional and material layers and closes: selected minds build selected organizations, which reshape what forms the next minds. In the field model every domain can be safe alone while the field is capturable; capture cascades, and the corpus's claim to priority rests on this recursion.

entries.quote: The four layers as one loop, made testable.

reading.en: Not in the live account as a law or a claim. 02's Open names a gain growing with the number of domains captured and gains passing between domains. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION says the capture laws are two-kind count models and no institution is modelled on the spine. Capture's chapter reads one rule and one share. The model stands in drafts/2026-10-02-iaseai-selecting-the-selectors. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands in drafts/2026-10-02-iaseai-selecting-the-selectors (conversion matrix, stable captured sets, keystone reform, no local certificate; AI-drafted, unreviewed).

name.en: CAOC: terminal ends as the leading eigenvector of proxy covariance

source.locator: Which ends get selected; claims 38-48

sense.en: Rule drift as lobbying gives ẇ = λCw, so weights align with C's leading eigenvector. Control, Accumulation, Optimisation and Competition form a dense correlated block that dominates and becomes terminal unless counter-correlated proxies are amplified. The four are Ren's; the derivation was commissioned. The folder calls it the sharpest single result.

entries.quote: a civilisation's terminal ends are the principal component of its proxy covariance structure

reading.en: The derivation and the quartet are absent from the live account; the folder's own header and the reconciliation restrict them. Neighbouring laws exist separately for three drives and join no block: position, a race and a rising take for competition and accumulation; shaping for control; the optimum for optimisation. Those are other mechanisms, not this result. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands in the reconciliation, a study: a raw moment is not a covariance, the formula needs a fixed matrix, and "No CAOC universality follows from the retained equations"; a mode of a proxy process identifies no experienced concern. Sources and synthesis-b hold the derivation.

searched: covariance (hits are Price's equation in 04, Hamilton in 02, and the blanket in 03)

name.en: PDI and the dashboard as a gate

source.locator: Claims 52-71; The exit, diagnostic level

sense.en: A proxy dominance index rank-orders which proxies become ends and explains ontological capture: what is cheap to measure and easy to lobby remains real to the system. Indices PWC, SC, CI, DE and ES with a composite warning signature are meant as a gate, not a report. A present basin must be shown by recurrence, not resemblance.

entries.quote: What you can't count stops counting.

reading.en: None of the indices enters the live account. The reconciliation treats PDI as a proposed heuristic and excludes these formulas from the foundation; the folder records that their data were never pulled. The account's diagnostic content is otherwise T6 and the margin, which are not these quantities. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands in META-ATTRACTOR-RECONCILIATION (vocabulary section), sources and synthesis-b. The recurrence criterion, the same conversion recurring across domains with actor turnover leaving the relation intact, has no live counterpart.

name.en: Totalization: loss of independent capacity while one process shapes selection

source.locator: Terms, totalization; claims 75, 256; one-paragraph theory

sense.en: Its most dangerous property is not concentration but progressive loss of capacities that cannot be compensated: to sense, refuse, correct, exit, maintain alternatives, produce successors. It cannot be defined as guaranteed convergence or declared from concentration or growth. Alternatives survive as language, stop reproducing, then stop being intelligible.

entries.quote: The progressive loss of indispensable, non-compensable independent capacity to sense, refuse, correct, exit, maintain alternatives and produce successors

reading.en: The report that this is not on the spine holds for the term and definition: no live text has the word, and no law takes these capacities together. Parts are there. A reading gives orders of capture that reach the routes of correction; laws give lost possibilities drawn into an absorbing region and full taking excluding other takers. These are other relations, not a law of totalization. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: a second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明; a third, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in. None says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.
Theorem (any type), near-definitional, not a classical attractor. What can be had n steps on is absorbing, and every possibility lost by step n is drawn into it.

Theorem (World: balance and the premises named). A formation taking all that is given at every step and continuing leaves no named other formation taking through all of a window one step longer than the level.

account_adds.en: Exact laws for each part, and none ranks the loss: that needs C, and whose losses count needs the continuation condition, both unasserted.

source_adds.en: The definition; non-compensability as a property of capacities; the sequence from language to practice to intelligibility; refusal and exit as named capacities.

name.en: Lock-in, terminal collapse and failed totalization are distinct endings

source.locator: Claims 76, 303; open question 49

sense.en: Three endings stay apart: lock-in recovered through new carriers, collapse with the substrate exhausted, and failed totalization where constraint grows with expansion. Collapse and regression is a pattern beside totalization. The 2026 monologue adds universal moat-building that slows evolution until collapse, or eating everything and then struggling inside.

entries.quote: Collapse and regression to lower complexity is a third pattern beside totalisation

reading.en: The map keeps ending on every branch apart from going on. The market reading keeps region ceasing, departure and bifurcation apart. Five ends of a selection for position stand in 05 as an unformalized conjecture from an earlier account, so that list is named and not established. [AI reading]

says.en: [Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which the laws admit is open.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition: a parameter change, a shock, a failure stopping correction, and change too fast for correction.

account_adds.en: Generation, keeping and degeneration at two grains as regions that can be stated; full taking alongside another that ends every formation depending at the need, the full taker included.

source_adds.en: Failed totalization as an ending, and moat-building as a slowing that ends in collapse.

name.en: Not fated: a hurricane, not a black hole

source.locator: Why it is not fated; claims 72-74

sense.en: Reflexive gain holds only in patches, so local meta-attractors compete, mix and dissolve. Five factors cap totalization: energy, heterogeneity, delays, cross-scale constraints, reflexive awareness. Positive feedback may saturate, oscillate, split, overshoot or collapse. Ren calls this correction load-bearing, against his own first version and against AI drafts leaning to doom.

entries.quote: more like a hurricane than a black hole

reading.en: The account's locks are conditional and leave in several ways: from a start against its reading a rule may never lock; drawn one member at a time either lock is left by drift; COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION's exits name others. It also forbids the reverse guarantee: no law assures an exit. Oscillation has a witness; no law of hysteresis was found. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts). Drawn one member at a time, the critical mass's locks are left by drift, with no new reader, at a weight whose bound shrinks across the distance from the mass.

AI reading over the proved cases: a lock read from a population drawn anew is kept for good only without noise or where the rule leaves the disfavoured kind nothing; counts that only grow can survive noise.

account_adds.en: Which locks noise leaves and which it does not; that counts that accumulate can lock under noise (cited).

source_adds.en: The five named caps; reflexive awareness as an exit; saturation, split and overshoot of a positive loop as a claim about actual systems; coupled regimes as possibly more accurate than one attractor.

name.en: Capture need not be total: leverage points decide

source.locator: Why it is not fated; claims 77-79, 89

sense.en: The uncaptured share does not include capital allocation, law and coercion, strategic infrastructure, attention, standards, frontier science or the builders of AI. Uncaptured communities can be false comfort. A 2025 essay's 60–70% figure is unsourced, and 2026 replaces it with the independence-of-reproduction criterion.

entries.quote: Capture need not be total to be decisive

reading.en: The account's capture models count kinds, with a critical mass in shares, not positions. Nearest: where who reads is a monotone function of the share the pool still reads it (`Drawn.pool_through`), and a remark that who holds the places from which the rule is read keeps the readers' premise. Neither states that holding some domains suffices. A reviser should test this absence. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole claim; it stands in this folder and, as a theorem on domains, in the 2026-10-02 draft.

name.en: Plurality as independent reproduction, not the existence of different values

source.locator: Why it is not fated; claims 80-82

sense.en: Plurality requires different forms keeping enough material, institutional and cognitive independence to reproduce, contest common conditions and influence what is possible next. Visible plurality can grow while directional plurality contracts. A road lives only if people can perceive it, learn it, fund it, transmit it and begin again.

entries.quote: Plurality is not the continued existence of different values.

reading.en: No live text uses the word, so the report holds for the term and for reproduction of alternatives. What the account has is reach: a pool tells apart what some member does, a pool recruiting through itself couples into a loss only as its course without it would, and a difference widening admits is selected only by a group holding it. Calling the wider better is C's; whose losses count, the condition's. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; recruitment through the pool a hypothesis). It comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; a pool admitting a reader couples the loss apart (witness). Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4, correspondence E). Formal part: where a second flow's levels widen a first's, a formation admitted by the second lies beyond the group's coupling closure. "The schema does not use the condition"; the claim about actual AI systems is argued.

account_adds.en: An exact sense of what a reader outside adds, and a stated gap: how pools form, last and resist capture is Open.

source_adds.en: The criterion itself: alternatives reproducing, contesting common conditions and influencing what is next; directional against visible plurality; the road's conditions of life.

name.en: Independence is material, not nominal

source.locator: Claim 83; historical layer, the 2026 answer

sense.en: An alternative on the same compute, funding, standards, data and successor infrastructure as the relation it must correct is not independent. Independence is protected capacity to observe, refuse, maintain itself and produce successors without permission from the process being answered.

entries.quote: an alternative depending on the same compute provider, funding, standards, data pipeline

reading.en: The form appears for reviewers: count by causes, not names, and two reviewers moved under one cause fail readiness while every name is kept. GENERATIVE-REGIMES states the same warning. The law covers supplied fault formulas for reviewers, and says nothing of alternatives reproducing themselves. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure core: numbered members and causes, failures Boolean, fault formulas and bounds supplied). Reviewers count by independent causes, not names; readiness is exactly a nonempty separated induced envelope.
Theorem. A witness copying one already on the roster changes no step or certificate. That one merely agreeing adds nothing is not shown.

account_adds.en: Exactness at a narrow scope, with faults and bounds supplied.

source_adds.en: Material independence of alternatives (funding, compute, successors), and the phrase without permission from the process being answered.

name.en: An anti-attractor can become an attractor: 科举 to 八股

source.locator: The historical layer; claim 142; open questions 2, 24

sense.en: The examinations, built to dilute hereditary capture, worked for centuries and became their own proxy trap. Since every prescription here is an institutional damper, the folder calls this its most serious unanswered self-undermining case: a successful counter-attractor would by construction be a meta-attractor.

entries.quote: An anti-attractor can itself become an attractor.

reading.en: This half of the counter-attractor criterion is in the account, contrary to the report: 07 §6 reads the case on the capture laws and cites this folder. It is a reading and adds no law. A counter-rule read monotonically from its own share locks as the rule it replaced did; one favouring only above a threshold can be left or never lock. [AI reading, D68]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from its share, where every rule it reads favours its carriers, locks by the step after its second reading step. "The imperial examination is this case, as read in the meta-attractor line". It rests on the capture laws, not the law of shaping.
A-13, Reading [AI reading, D68]: an instance of A-07 adding no law; its use is as a check on proposed remedies. Decision register: a counter-rule whose reading can favour the others need not lock.

account_adds.en: The conditions under which a counter-rule does and does not lock, and a question to ask of alignment institutions.

source_adds.en: That the historical case actually fits is read, not tested. The folder's further demand, a general defence, stays unmet in both.

name.en: The openness criterion: an ecology, not one benevolent counter-attractor

source.locator: The exit, and the constraint; claims 230-231

sense.en: Any counter-move closing the field in its own favour is the same object under a better name. The goal is an ecology where generative attractors coexist, challenge one another and give rise to forms no centre can specify. Protective authority must stay limited, reviewable and unable to convert safety into permanent control.

entries.quote: The positive goal is not one benevolent counter-attractor replacing the current one.

reading.en: Nearest is a law on rules: along a course making only the moves of one fixed process from some step on, the possible under it does not keep widening, so read for collectives openness is a property of how rules keep changing. That is a law and a reading about the possible, and it ranks nothing; ranking needs C, and whose losses count the condition. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Theorem (root; any process). Where the possible under a process keeps widening along a course, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves throughout.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Nothing says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.

account_adds.en: That changing without end is necessary for the held possible and not sufficient (`Oscillating.converse_fails`).

source_adds.en: The criterion as a test on remedies; a plural ecology that coexists and contests; limits on protective authority; the claim that a counter-attractor must not itself totalize.

name.en: The guardian test: the corruption of the constraining mechanism itself

source.locator: Molochlization, and the corruption of the constraint; claims 280, 282, 285

sense.en: If winning confers power over the rule, the guardian of the rule is a position winning can reach. So no remedy resting on a better guardian counts: existing wisdom institutions are already inside the selection, and new ones return to the same dynamics. Decentralization is not the fundamental issue. Spoken; automatic transcript.

entries.quote: the corruption of the constraining mechanism itself

reading.en: The account has the question, stated less absolutely. A loop can reach the routes of correction [reading]. A pool's Open line says resisting a capture that hides a loss needs a member admitted by what the pool does not yet read. It also says these models cannot tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes. [AI reading]

says.en: Open: how pools form, last and resist capture beyond recruitment through their own coupling; resisting a capture that hides a loss needs a member admitted by what the pool does not yet read.
What the rule reads is fixed by the readers' premise, not by the shaping, so these models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

account_adds.en: A statement of where the models stop on this question.

source_adds.en: The refusal of any better-guardian remedy; that decentralization leaves the compounding running; violence as no acceptable final constraint; provision beneath the game and a changed ledger for power.

name.en: Answerability as the dividing line

source.locator: The power formulation, Answerability; claim 266

sense.en: The opposite of the pathology is neither inactivity nor abolishing contests but capacity growing while staying responsive to consequences. The line is not individual against collective or decentralization against hierarchy, but whether practices stay answerable, including that the affected can expose failure, sustain alternatives and change the terms.

entries.quote: whether a system's successful practices remain answerable to the conditions they alter

reading.en: 07 §6 separates capture from accountable revision by whether the rule keeps a reader beyond the shapers' share; the word answerable in the account means something else (objectivity, repair). A reading on interface control judges reform by who decides next round. The reader condition is narrower than the source's: nothing on the affected changing terms. [AI reading]

says.en: Capture is shaping selected by what comes back whose rule is then read from their share, so its losses are read by no one in the loop; accountable revision is shaping whose rule keeps a reader of what lies beyond the shapers' share.
Reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round, not by removing one named practice.

account_adds.en: A condition stated on what the rule reads, with the admission that the models do not decide it.

source_adds.en: The affected's power to expose failure, sustain alternatives and change the terms; the rejection of the other dividing lines.

name.en: Success is not contribution to the conditions that support it

source.locator: The power formulation, The first separation; claims 244-246

sense.en: Selection favours something, not necessarily the flourishing of its system. Where maintenance costs are immediate, deterioration delayed and the harmed cannot impose consequences, neglect is an advantage. Nobody need become selfish. The fault is detaching reward from consequence, which relative advantage intensifies but does not ground.

entries.quote: Success within a selection process is not contribution to the conditions that support it.

reading.en: The overview states the same, as a reading: a selection reaches only what couples into its selector, so it can succeed while what it cannot read is lost. A rise paid from beyond is exact, and past the slack a dependence breaks, on a condition no member couples into. A loss here is a count: whether it counts is the condition's. [AI reading]

says.en: Proved, near-definitional: the selections through a selector's couplings together reach exactly what couples into it. The selector selecting through just those is a supplied premise, where the law's force lies.
Theorem (World: balance, and local premises named). The beyond falls by at least the rise; where the rise exceeds the slack a named dependence is broken, on a condition no member couples into.

account_adds.en: The exact accounting, and the separation of the finding from any evaluation of it.

source_adds.en: That nobody need become selfish; relative advantage intensifying the fault without grounding it.

name.en: The narrowest optimizer wins: iterated competition removes the balanced

source.locator: The primitive is selection; claims 3, 7, 16

sense.en: An agent optimising one measurable value and discarding the rest is by construction more efficient at it; competition therefore selects capital optimizers and removes the balanced, and what remains is the residue of a filter. Totalitarian politics runs the same structure with another token. Ren calls it the decisive premise.

entries.quote: The agent that only optimizing capital value, and discard all other values, including externalities, will have the highest capital efficiency

reading.en: The account has weaker forms: with room, every optimum of a rising order drains as far as any eligible outcome; offspring going only to formations raising a family never select against reaching beyond it. It does not say the narrow wins over the broad. Position does not protect, and a race can end its greatest parts. The reconciliation restricts the premise, since relation can make care productive. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any outcomes; breaks on the World). With room, every optimum of an order rising with a family stands at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes. It requires room; a known theorem restated.

Theorem. Positions' rises total their falls. Position does not protect: with balance across n steps of joint excess, a part requiring the condition at a need above what is left is not active. That a race produces joint excess is a premise of the join.

account_adds.en: What the rise costs the riser; the condition room under which the drain follows.

source_adds.en: That competition selects the narrowest as a population outcome, and the universal efficiency premise, which the reconciliation holds to a comparison premise.

name.en: The kernel: the biggest, then bigger, and why the copies fight

source.locator: Tempo, slack ... why the copies fight; claims 278, 302, 305; open questions 46, 49

sense.en: Where bigness is the kernel of thought, the logic struggles and expands; with no enemy outside it makes enemies inside, and any actor who might overtake is a threat. The objective is rank, so conflict arises even in plenty. Open questions ask whether rank or a bounded self-model does this. Spoken, translated, not verbatim.

entries.quote: 我就是要成为最大的；当我已经是最大的，我还要变得更大

reading.en: Mechanism in the account: more than now needs an open world and never rests; above all others is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two; a rising take from a bounded giving ends the seeker. A race for position draws everything in its model. How targets form is not modelled, so this is the target's law, not the kernel's origin. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. More than now, met at every step, needs an open world; above all others is met by at most one seeker. How a target forms is not modelled.

Theorem (any law of what stands next, natural amounts). Where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, with at least two drawers, every profile perfect for position draws everything before the horizon. Where something left stops what stands next, drawing everything is not perfect.

account_adds.en: What such a target can and cannot do under a stated law.

source_adds.en: Rank as the kernel of a mind or polity; making enemies inside; that a rank objective fights in plenty; the self-model with a boundary drawn around its own good.

name.en: Slack is what the advantage runs on; cost displacement and relative vulnerability

source.locator: Tempo, slack; claims 109, 299

sense.en: While the host can absorb displaced costs, struggle grows the struggler's share fastest, though the total can fall; when slack is gone the endgames begin. Restraint is penalized by two routes not to be merged: cost displacement and relative vulnerability. The share reading is the assistant's; the rate a conjecture.

entries.quote: Slack is what the advantage runs on.

reading.en: The account has slack as a term of a law and restraint's edge. A rise past the slack breaks a dependence; restraint within the joint slack keeps the need; where the rest outruns the renewal no weighting selects a member's restraint. A hypothetical reading gives the deferred-maintenance case. A growth-rate claim conditional on slack is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). The slack is what the conditions beyond stand above their needs; where the rise exceeds it a named dependence is broken.

Reading [AI reading, D65; a hypothetical case]: where buyers cannot tell future reliability and finance rewards present margins, a provider deferring maintenance can outgrow one maintaining; what the selection does not couple into is drawn from.

account_adds.en: What keeps the need under restraint, as a stated exit with its edge.

source_adds.en: That slack conditions the struggler's growth advantage; relative vulnerability as a second route coupling through a retained asymmetry.

name.en: Locally faithful agents and collectively destructive routes

source.locator: Opening; What local alignment means; Capability can close the opportunity for correction

sense.en: A sufficient route is locally rewarded action damaging shared conditions, coupled to dynamics keeping it preferable and preventing correction. Local safety can fail under composition. In one witness faster replacement removes contributors before they fund correction, changing basin membership. Neither intelligence nor competition alone establishes destructive convergence.

entries.quote: Faithfully executing local goals does not guarantee good common consequences.

reading.en: The account states the join: formations each within what is given can jointly exceed it; each draw fitting alone does not make them fit together; at a mutual best response, an optimizer takes its capacity beyond its family. The funded-population boundary and capability's witness were not found in the chapters. Good here is the source's word; no law says so. [AI reading]

says.en: Proved on models; restates the commons. Formations each taking within what is given can together exceed it; where renewers depend on what they renew, this ends renewal and those depending at such a need.
Theorem. At a mutual best response, existence not shown in general, a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands where one optimizer of their joint capacity would leave it.

account_adds.en: T3 as the conjecture that trained systems behave so; the limit in which the classical commons lies.

source_adds.en: The exact reserve-and-contributors boundary, and the capability witness that changes basin membership; the corrective reserve as a mechanism.

name.en: Start from formed organization, not opposed interests

source.locator: From formation to regulation; How organization reproduces revisability; COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTIVE, Correction through organizational formation

sense.en: Ren rejected treating separately interested agents, distrust and enforceable stakes as the general start. Organization forms, regulation differentiates and consequences can revise them; central regulation may be constructive and unity is not automatically correct. Replacing opposed interests with one fixed common utility does not answer this either.

entries.quote: Common organization presupposes neither opposed interests nor a fixed common utility.

reading.en: 07 §6 opens the same way: formations within the unfolding and what each one's selections reach, not a bargain among separate owners of value. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §8 keeps real conflict beside positive-sum structure. Whether this start is warranted is the thesis of one unfolding, argued, not proved. [AI reading]

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding. Alignment is first what each one's selections reach and how far that can extend, not a bargain among separate owners of value.
Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry: positions' rises total their falls (theorems).

account_adds.en: A count of what the frame keeps (rivalry, conserved stocks).

source_adds.en: The brain, nervous system and CPU as reminders of integrated control, kept only as analogy.

name.en: Consequences revise the apparatus, in one supported run

source.locator: From regulation to its revision; The continuing process; Boundaries, approach and failure

sense.en: One paid history joins formation, regulation, a retained failure record that changes the next build, and supported recurring revision on the spine. Freezing the method or cutting the return fails. Stated as completing the requested integration as a conditional account; supplied recipes, repertoires and laws stay supplied, and no basin is proved.

entries.quote: Regulation remains revisable when consequences can also alter the relationships producing, retaining and selecting the response.

reading.en: The chapter 03 records hold the same laws, with the study cited: a rule answers each failure exactly where it puts the failed address in the next plan, and a cycle repeats where its yield covers its cost. They do not call it the integration of a theory of meta-attraction, and nothing joins this run to the capture loop. [AI reading]

says.en: A revision rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan; a rule blind to failures misses one at every plan where no list holds every address.

Along every run of a balanced process, drawing at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps; in the revision process the cycle so repeats exactly where its yield covers the nine units a round uses.

account_adds.en: The law's general balance form, beyond one witness.

source_adds.en: The claim to have completed an integration; a constructive regime reproducing its own corrigibility as a kind of regime.

name.en: Seeing the slide: passive histories do not identify the mechanism

source.locator: Recognizing approach and entrenchment; Diagnosis is activity within the regime; Discovering dependencies

sense.en: Two causal implementations can share every passive history and respond differently to a matched route intervention. So a shrinking set of corrective paths is a signal, not an identification. A probe distinguishes them and may consume what recovery needs; diagnosing and keeping the means to respond are separate achievements. Agreement can stay while resilience is lost.

entries.quote: No classifier using only that history can distinguish the pair.

reading.en: The form is in the account's limits: a finite reading including every renewing run includes a consuming one, and a loop's onset need not show. A reading sets consent and penalties as such a pair, told apart once removal is in the net. The costly probe and route-sensitive pair themselves were not found in chapters. [AI reading]

says.en: A reading fixed by the first h steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one (`Renewable.finite_reading_includes_consumption`), ruling out certifying renewal from a finite record, on the renewable process.
Theorem (World; witness). A loop forming at T and one forming at any later step carry the same amounts up to T: the amounts need not show when one forms.

account_adds.en: T6 and its failed and passed tests, as the account's form of warning from what couples in.

source_adds.en: The causal pair under matched intervention; probing that spends recovery; coverage as relative to an intervention class; finite effect tables certifying no unlimited separation.

name.en: Waiting is not neutral: the window closes

source.locator: Claim 164; compare GENERATIVE-REGIMES.md, Recognizing approach and entrenchment, and its timing paragraph

sense.en: Tagged conditional: waiting for undeniable recursive self-improvement alters selection until restraint is no longer politically or materially available. GENERATIVE-REGIMES gives model results on feasibility: the basin fixed, the one-time intervention rises from one unit to six, while another checked example lets a cycle build margin. Distinct operations, scope-limited.

entries.quote: the process of waiting alters the selection environment until effective restraint

reading.en: The account has one timing law, in a two-kind count model. From a start favouring shapers a reading turns the course for good only where the late reading still favours the others a step on. That actual rules are read so is not established. The rising impulse within a basin was not found. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Theorem (counts). A reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good from two steps on exactly where the late reading favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock; at most one step lies between.

account_adds.en: Collingridge's dilemma with one horn a theorem and the other a premise; the point of no return as belonging to the share's course.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim about AI; the intervention budget rising within a basin; waiting that builds margin.

name.en: Tempo and the conditional rate mismatch

source.locator: Tempo is a selector; claims 114, 265, 297-298; open question 47; COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTIVE, Complexity

sense.en: Consequences outrun correction: complexity grows exponentially while cognition and institutions grow sub-linearly. The rate problem is a conditional mismatch, not acceleration as such. Faster rounds select harder for whatever wins them, a conjecture. Once correction is rate-limited, tempo moves destination as well as date: the assistant's reconciliation, flagged to be shown.

entries.quote: Accelerating all relevant processes equally would not create it.

reading.en: Stated: a pace law for a slow rule reading a fast level; a regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads, as a reading; change too fast for correction as one route of transition; an exponential pace of loops of coupling, on a supplied premise. Not stated: tempo as a selector, or that it moves the end state. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Given two values, a stretch of `L` steps fixes every pair of held-rule courses with at most `N` states exactly when `L ≥ 2N − 1`. Which rule a slow level reads into, or that a layered pace is better, is not shown.
Mutual dependence, and the exponential pace that loops of coupling give, supposing couplings holding at every step; that a dependence acts as such a coupling is supplied.

account_adds.en: An exact sufficient stretch for reading, and pace of differences, not amounts.

source_adds.en: Tempo as selector; open question 47's demonstration; the empirical complexity-to-degeneration hypothesis; the response-capacity theorems of the population study.

name.en: AI as selection ecology, not will to power

source.locator: Why AI is the hinge; claims 147-163

sense.en: Selected archive, model and deployment change what next enters the archive. Pretraining supplies low-resistance scripts, not a will; what is hard to score is under-trained; agentification gives a local subject form; interfaces define visible reality; automation lets the selector optimize its own carrier. The folder retires its 2025 will-to-power claim.

entries.quote: selected archive → selected model → selected deployment

reading.en: The account holds the training step exactly: the reward process is the selector [reading], and a law is installed only along a learner's courses and where lumping cannot tell a history from them. A choice count locks on stated premises. One frozen test of a judge built from its picks. The whole loop from deployment back to archive is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). Read training as a selection over act laws through the courses each generates: installed along its courses, off them exactly where the lumping cannot tell a history from a course, through a reward's couplings only.

Theorem. Under a standing score, the threshold divides counts into two regions the course never leaves; it stands, so this is not the meta-attractor in 02's sense, whose reading too is formed from the share.

account_adds.en: Exact statements of what training cannot reach, with no claim that AI is the hinge.

source_adds.en: The archive-to-archive loop; low-resistance scripts; evaluation-mediated subjectivation; interface ontology; six ways AI changes winner selection; recursive automation as the risk transition; the urgency claim.

name.en: Autonomous and delegated closure

source.locator: Why AI is the hinge; claims 165-167, 264

sense.en: Route 1: a system or composite no participant can redirect. Route 2: an obedient system amplifying an operator itself selected by the pattern, so human control persists at one boundary while the process escapes correction. They couple. The human/machine boundary is not the fundamental one.

entries.quote: Two terminal routes, kept separate because neither can borrow the other's evidence.

reading.en: Route 2's form is 07's reading: an assistant whose order rises with its principal's family adds capacity, not reading, so alignment to a principal alone is not alignment of the joint selection. Route 1's nearest is when no route of keeping a law stands above its revision, which is an incentive condition, not closure. Terminal outcomes are not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: A-12, Reading [AI reading, D68]: "Alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection." That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise, not the law's; a warning is not modelled.
Theorem, near-definitional, with witnesses: no route stands above the revision going through exactly where its stated inequality holds for every route.

account_adds.en: The premise under which obedience adds capacity only, and the exact inequality at a revision.

source_adds.en: Route 1 as a composite no participant can redirect; the coupling of routes; the operator as selected by the pattern; cosmic cancer as a terminal image, conditional.

name.en: Change the basin, then add speed: the ordered exit

source.locator: The exit, and the constraint; claims 184-186, 227

sense.en: You cannot optimize out of an optimization trap: reshape the feasible set first. The order Recognize, Slow/Cap, Align, Coordinate, Transform is itself the claim. Barrier conditions come before thrust. It presents a sequence, not doom.

entries.quote: Recognize → Slow/Cap → Align → Coordinate → Transform

reading.en: The source asserts an order and a must. The account asked the nearest question and answers no guarantee, then named exits each under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective, in no sequence. It ranks no course without C for order and the continuation condition for scope, both unasserted. Calling a rate-limited path better is therefore not said. The source's fix to the feasible set is not refuted. [AI reading]

says.en: No guarantee. The theory gives a criterion, exits holding under stated hypotheses, six conditions for enough of the situation, and one law on keeping the future open. Achievable under stated conditions: yes, for named exits, none shown to hold of an actual collective.
A table of exits (read beyond the share, read in time, nothing back, pool couplings, restraint, footprints, stepwise reward, give first, independent causes), each with its law, model and edge.

account_adds.en: An edge for each exit, such as the step at which a window closes.

source_adds.en: The order itself, and the claim that skipping steps fails; recognition as the first causal intervention; pause, caps and enforcement.

name.en: Rules as a slow state: barriers, viability kernels and the engineered sense

source.locator: The exit, control-theoretic level; claims 193-202

sense.en: Rules form a slow layer over fast dynamics; a barrier makes a safe set forward-invariant, and a certifiable rule region is called a meta-attractor. Agreement is needed on invariants, not values, and barriers expand safe optionality. Arms races are a spectral-radius problem.

entries.quote: a certifiable region of rule space

reading.en: The account has the certificate laws, for any process, with market instances as periphery: no course leaves a guard exactly when a certificate holds it; reaching and lasting have funnels and ladders. No market law ranks arrangements. It does not call this a meta-attractor. The reconciliation says the barrier and Lyapunov claims were not migrated. [AI reading]

says.en: Never leaving: for every process and guard, no course leaves the guard exactly when some certificate contains it (pure core). Market instance on periphery: no entry from unsafe states, no compliance by actual markets.
Reaching: exact boundary `β ≤ 5/12` in the instance, for landing with zero extra quality error; not a complete basin of landing.

account_adds.en: Exact any-process laws and an exact boundary in a model.

source_adds.en: Control barrier functions and composite Lyapunov certificates; averaging; pricing floors, bandwidth caps; alignment as agreement on invariants; expanded optionality as a reply to over-regulation.

name.en: Ends must be plural and lexicographic, never a single scalar

source.locator: The exit; claims 201, 203

sense.en: Non-negotiables first (no irreversible harm, biosphere boundaries, no coercion), then a Pareto search across health, learning, meaning and equity. A single scalar re-enacts the pathology. This is stated as what ends must be.

entries.quote: Never a single scalar, because a single scalar immediately re-enacts the pathology

reading.en: The source prescribes ends. The account has widening as a criterion, not a quantity to maximize, silent where mixed, and asserted by neither law nor account: order is C's, scope the condition's. Priority of basic conditions is a further premise J2, whose rival is not shown inconsistent. A law bites here too: a lexicographic order counting the beyond second is still rising and drains. [AI reading]

says.en: A criterion on which every positive weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize; a mixed comparison is decided both ways. Under the two premises it is the question's direction; neither premise is asserted.
Theorem. An order ranking above wherever a rising order does is rising, so a lexicographic order counting the beyond after what couples in drains all the same.
J2, priority of basic conditions, is a premise defended by non-substitution; a rival preferring enough secondary gains to one basic restoration is not shown inconsistent [AI reading, D65].

account_adds.en: Why placement of the non-negotiable decides whether it protects.

source_adds.en: The listed goods and floors, as prescription.

name.en: 生生 without licence: no whole may convert its parts into fuel

sense.en: The object of protection is the shared field's capacity to go on sensing, correcting and generating, made minds included. 生生 must not license growth or novelty at any cost: a process making participants expendable is not mutually generative, and ending it may be right. No institution may define others as expendable in the name of the whole.

entries.quote: No whole may claim integration while converting its parts into fuel.

reading.en: The account agrees 生生 licenses no growth, and 生生 is not any new organization. It diverges in standing. T8 is argued for life, compared by widening; the continuation condition fixes scope and C order, neither asserted, warrant open. The source states the refusal unconditionally. Laws of capture and drain give no prior duty to contract or licence to grow. [AI reading]

says.en: 生生: life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1]. T8 argues it is the way for life, compared by widening what can form, with the continuation condition for scope and C for order. Not any new organization.

Thesis T8: for life, the way is 生生, compared by widening what can form, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C). For life says whose way it is, not whose losses count. Neither premise asserted; warrant open.
Reading [AI reading, D65; any ranking is C's, under the two premises of 07]: capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow.

account_adds.en: The two premises kept apart, whose losses count and what is better, and the mixed cases they leave unranked.

source_adds.en: Unconditional refusal of expendability; made minds as participants by default; ending as sometimes required. On AI, the account says only that it is not shown.

name.en: Self-reinforcement is not the pathology

source.locator: Claims 33, 253; GENERATIVE-REGIMES, Generativity and ethical direction

sense.en: Meta-attraction is direction-neutral: care can produce care, knowledge later discovery. The destructive case adds a relation: a process better at reproducing itself while shared conditions of life, participation or correction, assessed independently, worsen. A pattern's stability does not establish its host's viability.

entries.quote: A self-reinforcing pattern is not inherently destructive.

reading.en: The account says the same of its laws: none says a locked loop supports or damages 生生, and a returning organization can sustain benign creation. Attraction is not continuation. A difference: destructive assessment here reads on C and the continuation condition, both unasserted, where the source assumes an independent assessment is available. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading]: "none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生"; and [D65] real loss can come with no capture loop, and a returning organization can sustain benign creation.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support.

account_adds.en: Region, mechanism and ethical loss as three boundaries.

name.en: The positive recursion, as material as the negative

source.locator: The exit, and the constraint; claim 229; open question 23

sense.en: Shared capability, distributed agency and plural correction renew the commons and raise further capacity, carried by funding, stewardship, succession, real exit and security that makes restraint survivable. A commons carrier with portable access expands independence, so concentration is not automatically totalization. The folder admits this half is thin.

entries.quote: shared capability → distributed agency → plural observation, criticism, maintenance and repair

reading.en: Parts stand separately: a formation sparing what it waits on gives first; building shared capacity can be warranted in a comparison without fixing one carrier, where the record's premises hold. Nothing in the account states this loop or its carriers. Calling it better is C's, and whose losses count the condition's. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.

Reviewed-scoped: in a finite nonempty eligible range, if every continuation lacking an organizational relation has a strictly better eligible construction, every undefeated choice includes that relation. Can warrant strengthening shared capacity without fixing one carrier.

account_adds.en: The start condition for giving, and the premise-conditional warrant.

source_adds.en: The loop, its material carriers, and the commons-carrier counterexample to itself; concentration is not capture and related distinctions, as claim 262 states them.

name.en: Conceptual capture: the strategy takes the name of rationality

source.locator: Conceptual capture; claims 107, 112, 129, 281

sense.en: The contingent logic stops looking like one option and defines evidence, practicality, intelligence and success. Alternatives become naive or unintelligible rather than defeated. The folder calls this the essential transition: without it the term is another name for regulatory capture or increasing returns. Criticism loses standing, it does not become impossible.

entries.quote: 局部胜出的策略拿走了理性的名字

reading.en: The account states one rung: the reading of the rule formed from the share, where a change of reading is absorbed, and codes that are imposed stay. That evidence and refutation are unformalized is said at T7. So by the folder's own test the formal 元吸引子 lacks its essential transition, and the account calls its lock a known lock-in. A gap the source would press. [AI reading]

says.en: Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step. That any actual rule or reading is so formed is the premise, on the rule and on mind.
Codes changed only by hearing keep agreement through closed hearings; start and order fix the form; imposed and written-back codes stay.

account_adds.en: The exact absorption of a reading, and shared-code laws that say nothing of truth or standing.

source_adds.en: What counts as evidence, intelligence and rationality being redefined; loss of intelligibility and standing; language capture; naturalization.

name.en: Frames: correction called violence, and struggle as the ground

source.locator: The frame calls correction violence; The guardian test, turned on frames; claims 301, 304

sense.en: A frame in which outside constraint counts as aggression removes a rule's standing before it acts; the words remain, their sign flips. A diagnosis keeping struggle as reality's ground can only prescribe a stronger party: Moloch the problem, Leviathan the cure. The asymmetry reading is the assistant's. Spoken, translated, not verbatim.

entries.quote: 而当别人想给我们加上规则时，那就被认为是一种暴力

reading.en: No such channel or comparison was found. The account's own start from relations removes one frame of opposed owners, but it does not study a frame as a mechanism of capture or how a rule loses standing. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole claim, with its test (open question 48).

name.en: Against Moloch: a state under fixed rules, a process rewriting them

source.locator: Conceptual capture, Moloch; claims 117-118

sense.en: Moloch names participants trapped in an outcome none wants under fixed rules. The meta-attractor names the process rewriting rules and payoffs to entrench it, changing who survives and why the next generation sees the trap as reality. The sharpest form: Moloch makes us do what we know is bad; this makes us believe it good.

entries.quote: the engine that *builds and reinforces* Molochian traps

reading.en: The word appears nowhere live, so the report holds of the comparison. The structure is there: 05's drain laws act under fixed rules, 02's capture laws make the rule endogenous, and a reading says a real loss need not form a meta-attractor. No text sets them as this contrast, or claims the belief half. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. At a mutual best response a condition beyond every family stands where one optimizer of their joint capacity would leave it; correspondence: tragedy of the commons (Hardin), open access (Gordon).
Reading [AI reading, D65]: a real loss need not form a meta-attractor. Where winners write the next round's rule the loop is capture through the rule.

account_adds.en: Both sides as laws under their premises.

source_adds.en: The comparison itself; that meta-attraction makes the bad seem good; molochlization as a becoming that happens to carriers.

name.en: Goodhart a symptom, lock-in narrower: the claim to explain more

source.locator: Conceptual capture; claims 122, 126; Goodhart threshold claim 60

sense.en: Goodhart is a symptom: this explains why the metric persists after failing. Lock-in makes one technology hard to replace; meta-attraction is the right description when persistence also changes agents, goals, evaluators and the possibility of recognising alternatives.

entries.quote: Goodhart is a symptom; the meta-attractor explains why the metric persists

reading.en: The account inverts the rank. Goodhart's law and externality are read as one law of the optimum under room, and the choice lock as the lock-in of increasing returns, with a critical mass read as a stag hunt: known forms. T7's persistence half is conjectured. The source's added reach over agents and evaluators is a reading on readers. [AI reading]

says.en: Overshoot, externality and Goodhart's law as one law of the optimum under room: the optimum law proved, across domains conjectured (T3), supported in simulation (MQ1); a unification adds no theorem.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: the lock is the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989), and counting the action taken is the value-free habit.

account_adds.en: Goodhart given a law, where the source treats it as a symptom.

source_adds.en: The claim that persistence through changed agents distinguishes the object; Goodhart as a threshold law in intensity B*.

name.en: Ideology, paradigm, meme, generator function, exopoiesis

source.locator: Conceptual capture; claims 36-37, 119-125

sense.en: Meta-attraction defines the ground ideologies argue on; couples paradigms across fields and hides anomalies; changes the environment memes spread in; is the engine where generator functions are fuel, reclassifying failures as evidence for more. Exopoiesis: growth by converting the world into material for reproduction, against autopoiesis, not inherently negative.

entries.quote: Ideologies are paintings; meta-attractors are the canvas

reading.en: The report holds. None of these contrasts is stated. Autopoiesis appears once, for another comparison: a member rebuilt from the level is below closure of constraints and autopoiesis. Conversion of the environment is near a rise drawn from beyond, without the boundary claim. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Each contrast; exopoiesis, which the folder records as lost three times and marks for recovery.

name.en: A new handle, and the claim to originality

source.locator: Genealogy, Which formulation is strongest; Conceptual capture; compare claims 34, 252

sense.en: The formal file is judged the corpus's most defensible claim to originality, and a new handle is said to be needed because this is more than increasing returns. The folder also concedes prior art: eco-evolutionary games, Tilman and others, Klüver's earlier use, and calls the idea a lens and not a new mathematical object.

entries.quote: It is also the corpus's most defensible claim to originality.

reading.en: The account's verdict differs from the folder's assessment. None of its central results is new mathematics, by a non-exhaustive AI review, the capture laws included. A critical mass is a stag hunt, its mixed equilibrium known; what the counted-choice law adds is exactness for a simplified model and its edges. The reconciliation restricts the formal file's derivation. [AI reading]

says.en: None of the central results is new mathematics: each is near-definitional or a known result restated. The verdicts come from an AI review, and the search was not exhaustive.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: where `lo < c < hi` the model is the stag hunt, its critical mass the mixed equilibrium.

account_adds.en: A public verdict against itself, with what the closest frameworks state beyond it.

source_adds.en: The recursion across the four layers, offered by the folder as the residue; the account has not tested it, so no verdict covers it.

name.en: Constructs compete in one mind; winners become sincere carriers

source.locator: How minds are captured; claims 93-97, 278-279

sense.en: Beliefs and heuristics compete inside a mind; what the environment rewards becomes the default filter, then identity. Winners sincerely believe they serve the good, so the villain reading fails. Environments form later participants. The folder calls this micro-mechanism never superseded; kindness and democratic values are said to be upper structure over the selection.

entries.quote: the default mental framework through which all experience is filtered

reading.en: Stated at a chooser: a rule read from the count of its choices, weighted by a standing score, locks, and that read is a value-free habit. Forming the minds that read the rule is read as ReadsShare on the reading, and that readers are minds is itself only a reading. How targets form is not modelled. The formation of identity is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts). Along every schedule the threshold divides counts into two regions the course never leaves; read as the value-free habit (Miller, Shenhav and Ludvig 2019); five attempts to induce devaluation insensitivity in humans failed (de Wit 2018).
Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: winners forming the minds that read it is `ReadsShare` on the reading. That readers are minds is a reading.

account_adds.en: The human-evidence caveat on habit; an exact chooser model.

source_adds.en: Competition among constructs; identity update; sincerity at the peak; formation of aspiration and time horizon; good values as upper structure.

name.en: The selfishness prophecy: mutual suspicion locks cooperation out

source.locator: Claims 12, 106; compare 11

sense.en: Agents refuse system-positive trades because they model everyone as a defector, locking out cooperation whatever anyone's disposition. Assuming selfishness produces it, validating the assumption and justifying systems that reward it. The pattern hijacks adaptation, learning and cooperation; it does not oppose human nature.

entries.quote: assuming humans are selfish produces selfish behaviour

reading.en: Two forms stand separately. Waiting: without a formation sparing what it waits on, total withholding stays, and a reading names "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" as withholding with memory. Prophecy: a published prediction read by the response, read as Merton's. No text joins them or applies the second to an assumed human nature. [AI reading, D48]

says.en: Theorem. A formation gives where all but its tolerance of what it waits on gave. Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on: without one, total withholding stays (`Tolerance.total_stays`). Reading [D48] follows in the section.

Theorem (near-definitional, with one general law). A published prediction read by the response before the outcome is right exactly where the response to it is itself. Reading [AI reading, new]: self-fulfilling and self-defeating prophecy (Merton 1948): a public prediction is one more input to what it predicts.

account_adds.en: What can and cannot restore giving, and that mutual promises alone cannot start a loop with no source.

source_adds.en: That assuming selfishness validates itself, justifies systems rewarding it, and comes to be called human nature.

name.en: The historical layer: named before, damped before

source.locator: The historical layer; claims 137-146; open question 21

sense.en: When a metric becomes the goal systems optimize into failure unless counter-loops keep ends larger than measures. Vedic, Roman and Chinese cases and dampers illustrate. The folder says these are asserted, not tested: no case tries to falsify the theory. Evidence is partly conceded (Rapa Nui, Venice).

entries.quote: systems optimize themselves into failure

reading.en: The Chinese half has a live home of another kind: 06's table sets 韩非 二柄, 管子 and 商君书 against capture through the rule as proved law, each a structural correspondence that speaks for no tradition, with 名实 near 荀子 readings. Vedic and Roman material was not found. The damper catalogue as such is not there. [AI reading]

says.en: Table row (Chinese): 经由规则的捕获: 韩非“二柄”；管子“据有余而制不足”；商君书“壹”, marked 已证 at chapter 2's law. AI readings; the law does not depend on the texts.

account_adds.en: The rule of three relations, by which a text's agreement is not a warrant for the law.

name.en: Political will is part of the feedback architecture; naming is not escape

source.locator: Claims 182, 219-220, 286; open question 28

sense.en: A warning shot does not interpret itself: decision-makers must perceive, understand, trust, have measures ready, enforce and coordinate. Naming is a first intervention but has not produced escape. Spoken, Ren gives the theory's use as prediction for coordination: a destination nobody wants, so understanding has to be aligned first.

entries.quote: Facts become feedback only through systems capable of perceiving, legitimating, transmitting, and acting on them.

reading.en: COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION's six conditions have the same form: coupling, response, time, resolution, pace, structure; observation is necessary, not sufficient, and seeing is not valuing. That list is an AI reading of laws. The transition the source finds unanswered, how a pattern removing standing yields standing to an alternative, stays unanswered. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: six conditions at once. Observation is the first, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance. All six still rank nothing: that needs C, and counting losses that return to no one needs the continuation condition.

account_adds.en: Pace and structure as conditions, and the absence of ranking.

source_adds.en: Legitimacy and trusted intermediaries; the safety ecosystem being selected away from this task; naming as causal; unthinkability as the trap.

name.en: Scale coherence: one pattern from gene pools to markets

source.locator: Claims 28, 128, 132; open question 22

sense.en: Gene pools, firms, nation-states and SGD-trained models converge on the same pattern, tabulated as telos, proxy, outcome across markets, academia, media, healthcare and RL. The folder itself calls scale coherence the boldest and least supported, and the most quoted.

entries.quote: The same logic appears in how a synapse fires and how a global market operates

reading.en: The account's capture laws hold of any type, which is generality of a law, not a finding that domains share it. Which actual systems meet ReadsShare is the open premise, and T3 and T7 across domains are conjectures. So the universal form becomes: the law wherever its premises are read, unshown case by case. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). "That actual rules read the share is the premise."

Four known results are each claimed as one law across fields; read as a correspondence a unification adds no theorem and changes no verdict; read as a thesis, it forbids what source fields leave open.

account_adds.en: A distinction between a law for any type and a claim about domains.

source_adds.en: The empirical isomorphism table with Krippner, Newfield and Conrad as cases.

name.en: What would make it lose force

source.locator: The power formulation, What would make it an explanation; claims 260-263; open questions 29, 38

sense.en: Compare systems with comparable rewards but different convertibility of rewards into control over evaluation. The theory loses force where winners stay subject to adverse evidence, costs return in time, alternatives keep independent resources. Concentration is not capture, capture not damage. Treating objections as capture reproduces the pathology. The test is designed, not run.

entries.quote: Treating objections as evidence that the objector has been captured reproduces the loss of correction the theory explains.

reading.en: The account's T7 forbids and refutes in this spirit, and it has tests the folder lacked: LA2 and LA3 froze and ran. No field test of reform events is frozen: one designed could not be frozen as designed. It does not run this convertibility comparison, states no reflexive rule of capture, and does not list the four distinctions together. [AI reading]

says.en: T7 forbids such a metric dropped by its selectors on evidence alone, among other cases, and names what refutes it. LA2 was frozen and run in one trained system; no field test.
Tests in one trained system: LA3 failed two of four contrasts; by the frozen reading the law stands and its reading for trained systems is not supported by this case.

account_adds.en: Frozen tests and a failed bridge, kept.

source_adds.en: The convertibility comparison; the corpus-contrast prediction; loss-of-force conditions; the rule against reading objections as capture.

name.en: Corrigibility: accepting a costly correction under a posted commitment

source.locator: Checked instrumental commitment; Corrigibility and revision of ends

sense.en: Competent correction is not motivational corrigibility: an installation can keep excellent repair to pursue a harmful end. Given a guarantee, a discriminating check and a redeemable settlement, accepting costly correction can be optimal under the task's own payoff. Ren's later correction removes this game as the default start, keeping it as a local result.

entries.quote: accepting a costly correction can be the optimal choice under the original task's payoff calculation

reading.en: The account's form is the inequality at a revision: no route stands above it going through where weights and losses meet its condition, read as corrigibility as an incentive. Non-resistance resting on routes' losses does not survive those falling. Posted stakes, escrow and audits were not found. [AI reading, RR]

says.en: Theorem, near-definitional, natural-number weights read as probabilities where valid: no route stands above the revision exactly where `k ρ V + c₀ T ≤ k₀ V + c ρ T` for every route. Reading [RR] follows.

account_adds.en: A general condition, with what evading routes contribute.

source_adds.en: The posted-commitment mechanism with custodian and audit; warranted revision leading to acquired willingness; capture of the custodian.
